races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Race
races.verdict:
FIGHTING TEARS overcame inexperience to make a winning start at the Curragh last month, a performance deserving of extra credit given she fared easily best of those that raced towards the stand side, so she's taken to maintain her unbeaten record. The Scallionator is an obvious threat down markedly in grade, as is Zoar, who looked potentially useful when scoring on his second start at Naas recently.

  1. FIGHTING TEARS (IRE)
  2. THE SCALLIONATOR (IRE)
  3. ZOAR (USA)

races.name: Coolmore Stud Gleneagles Irish EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
MARCO POLO was caught out by the quick step up in grade at York last time but he had shaped with plenty of promise on debut and looks to have been found an ideal opportunity to get off the mark. Timucua Gold is bred more for speed than stamina and should be suited by the 6f trip, while Revelator took a step forward when third at Navan.

  1. MARCO POLO (IRE)
  2. TIMUCUA GOLD (USA)
  3. REVELATOR (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
GERRIT'S GEM shaped as if back in better form last time and is taken to repeat last season’s win in this race from just a 2 lb higher mark. All The Girls ran a cracker at Dundalk last time and rates the main danger if proving as effective back on turf, while Grande Cuvee is open to improvement now handicapping and Soulful Diva remains capable from her current mark.

  1. GERRIT'S GEM (IRE)
  2. ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)
  3. GRANDE CUVEE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SARAH'S CHOICE returned amiss last time but remains with potential on the strength of her debut second in a Naas listed event. Alpine Wedding is also amongst the form choices of those with experience, whilst Castilian Queen and Emana are perhaps most appealing of the newcomers.

  1. SARAH'S CHOICE (IRE)
  2. ALPINE WEDDING (IRE)
  3. CASTILIAN QUEEN

races.name: Follow Us On X Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
SAYONARA arrives on the back of 3 consecutive in-frame efforts and Andy Slattery's 3-y-o can get off the mark. Cannonball Queen is next on the shortlist, with Whatswrongnow, She's On The Ball and Micasso also worth considering.

  1. SAYONARA (IRE)
  2. CANNONBALL QUEEN (IRE)
  3. WHATSWRONGNOW (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Social Media Maiden
races.verdict:
ALMEIYDA showed improved form when runner-up twice this summer and, having had excuses last time, she is fancied to get off the mark. The main danger could be Enigma Code, who made an encouraging debut at Gowran recently, while Nottooshabby shaped well on his latest outing.

  1. ALMEIYDA (IRE)
  2. ENIGMA CODE
  3. NOTTOOSHABBY (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again September 29th Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider with the vote going to improving 3-y-o filly SHEREKIYA after her close third at the Curragh. Autumn Twist, Greek Flower and Highbury See See are on potentially handy marks so they head the dangers.

  1. SHEREKIYA (IRE)
  2. AUTUMN TWIST (IRE)
  3. GREEK FLOWER (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 14th September Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of these are particularly convincing but EARNEST BELIEF stayed well on the level so this trip may well unlock a bit more on the back of a breathing operation. Datstheholyallofit and Way Maker are the viable threats.

  1. EARNEST BELIEF (IRE)
  2. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)
  3. WAY MAKER (IRE)

races.name: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
STELLARMASTERPIECE has been thriving this summer and can complete a cross-code 5-timer, with the steadily progressive Curious Mrs Fox rating as the main danger.

  1. STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR)
  2. CURIOUS MRS FOX
  3. SPOT ON SOPH (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GLENMALURE FLYER has made a fine start for the Skelton yard and an 8 lb rise might not get to the bottom of her given her current rate of improvement over fences. Limerick Leader dominated from the front at Bangor last week and might pose the main threat if getting another easy lead this time.

  1. GLENMALURE FLYER (IRE)
  2. LIMERICK LEADER (FR)
  3. THANK YOU BLUE

races.name: Winning Connections Conference Hire Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DEXTER remains on a competitive mark and is weighted to this time get the better of Getaway Jewel, who bested him at Worcester 3 weeks ago and has since run well enough at Cartmel. Tropical Talent is also shortlisted in a race that lacks depth.

  1. DEXTER (FR)
  2. GETAWAY JEWEL (IRE)
  3. TROPICAL TALENT

races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
GLORY AND HONOUR has recaptured his form this season and with 10-lb claimer Rebecca Hitchen retaining the ride, is fancied to notch a second win of the campaign. Loriko has had a productive summer but his mark now looks on the harsh side for winning a couple of thin, small-field events. However, he can still prove the biggest threat ahead of Ladies Day.

  1. GLORY AND HONOUR (IRE)
  2. LORIKO (FR)
  3. LADIES DAY (IRE)

races.name: Fairlight Studios Cafe At Sedgefield Racecourse Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MORO ROCK wasn't disgraced returning from a 10-month absence in a race that's worked out well at Market Rasen in June and, having slipped below his sole winning mark, he could be the answer. Dr Seb is worth another chance to build on a mildly encouraging stable debut now dropped further in grade and is narrowly preferred for forecast purposes to stablemate East Eagle, who is back up in the weights after running out a wide-margin winner of a thin race at Stratford.

  1. MORO ROCK (IRE)
  2. DR SEB (FR)
  3. EAST EAGLE (IRE)

races.name: Whitegates Nursery Northallerton Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Jennie Candlish has 2 strong contenders in PERGAMON and Saint Polo with preference for the former, who has a fine strike rate at around this trip.

  1. PERGAMON (FR)
  2. SAINT POLO (FR)
  3. KING ULANDA (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Handicap
races.verdict:
VIKING GLORY took a big step forward when returning to 7f with first-time cheekpieces at Brighton last month, and there should be more to come from James Owen's gelding now connections have figured him out. Violet Goldsmith arrives in good form following a creditable effort when stepped up in grade at Salisbury and can go well if proving as effective on all-weather, whilst The Bureau Club is dropped 5 lb after shaping well when not ideally placed at Chepstow so has to be considered.

  1. VIKING GLORY (IRE)
  2. VIOLET GOLDSMITH
  3. THE BUREAU CLUB (FR)

races.name: Unibet/Breeders Backing Racing EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MERCANTILE was the only one to threaten the winner on his Southwell debut 24 days ago despite running green and is open to further improvement, making him the selection here. Sea Brave has been runner-up twice including over C&D a fortnight ago and can strip fitter for that reappearance, whilst Venetian Sky has plenty of experience under her belt for top connections so should figure.

  1. MERCANTILE
  2. SEA BRAVE (IRE)
  3. VENETIAN SKY (FR)

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap
races.verdict:
BETWEEN ME AND U proved better than ever when completing the hat-trick at Carlisle 3 weeks ago, showing a good attitude, and he is taken to add to his tally in current form. Heading the list of dangers is 5-time course winner Arctician having dropped to a handy mark, with Asteverdi completing the shortlist.

  1. BETWEEN ME AND U
  2. ARCTICIAN (IRE)
  3. ASTEVERDI

races.name: Unibet Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PINK LARKSPUR is a well-bred £150,000 purchase from a family that includes smart sprinter Wizz Kid and is taken to make a winning debut for top yard. Dreamology, a $600,000 buy and half-sister to useful US Grade 3 winner Royal Approval, is another fascinating newcomer and represents a significant threat, while Lex Victoria won her debut and sets a reasonable standard for them to try and surpass.

  1. PINK LARKSPUR (IRE)
  2. DREAMOLOGY (USA)
  3. LEX VICTORIA (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ENCHANTED QUEEN ran to a fairly useful level when placed all 3 starts as a juvenile for Charlie Appleby so, provided she's ready to roll after an 11-month absence. George Boughey's new recruit gets the verdict to open her account. Yimmna has upped her game since her debut and she may have to settle for a third silver medal on the spin, with debutant Noozhaa rounding off the shortlist.

  1. ENCHANTED QUEEN
  2. YIMMNA (FR)
  3. NOOZHAA

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for MUSICAL SOLDIER, who went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up in his bid for a 4-timer at Lingfield last week. He can quickly resume winning ways, though Dandy G Boy is respected back on all-weather and Penfolds Grange could go well having not been seen to best effect on his latest outing.

  1. MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE)
  2. DANDY G BOY (IRE)
  3. PENFOLDS GRANGE

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
A 7-time course winner, UZINCSO arrives in good heart and is now 1 lb lower in the weights than when he landed this race last year. He gets the vote ahead of Goldfinder, who has had excuses on his last 2 starts, while Birthday Angel is also considered.

  1. UZINCSO
  2. GOLDFINDER
  3. BIRTHDAY ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Interactive Handicap
races.verdict:
AUGUSTUS GLOOP ran his best race when making the frame here a fortnight ago, despite meeting trouble at the start, and he looks up to gaining a first handicap success. He can reverse the form with Bintaryana from last time who is the pick for second, with Art Lover another who could be in the mix.

  1. AUGUSTUS GLOOP
  2. BINTARYANA
  3. ART LOVER (IRE)

races.name: Quooker Tap 100 Degrees EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FLOWER YOUMZAIN holds the clear edge on the form of her recent Beverley third and with this step back up in trip also a plus she looks the way to go. Karl Burke's Minzaal newcomer Lady Foxtrot could emerge as the main danger ahead of Orfilia and Tradittion.

  1. FLOWER YOUMZAIN (IRE)
  2. LADY FOXTROT (IRE)
  3. ORFILIA

races.name: Andersons - Quality For The Home Nursery
races.verdict:
A few with chances but FAST PERFORMER is worth siding with to bounce back from his odds-on Newmarket reverse and belatedly confirm debut Nottingham promise now going into nurseries for his in-form yard. State of Gold is feared most on the back of her Beverley victory (form franked), although Caturra Lights and North Star Kodi can both play a prominent role, too.

  1. FAST PERFORMER
  2. STATE OF GOLD (IRE)
  3. CATURRA LIGHTS

races.name: LPD Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LORD BYRON developed into a classy juvenile hurdler for Faye Bramley in the spring and is worth siding with to get off the mark on just his third Flat run. Blue Hercules remains winless but has the form to play a leading part and is next on the list ahead of Harper Violet and Act of Generosity in this intriguing maiden.

  1. LORD BYRON (IRE)
  2. BLUE HERCULES (IRE)
  3. HARPER VIOLET (IRE)

races.name: Deanta Fire Door Handicap
races.verdict:
A tightknit sprint but ROYAL DUKE got back to winning ways over C&D last time and is weighted to go well again here so edges the vote from Bibendum who didn't enjoy the smoothest of runs when fifth that day. Both Cotai Starlight and Go Victor also need considering.

  1. ROYAL DUKE
  2. BIBENDUM
  3. COTAI STARLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Quickstep Supporting Andersons Autumn Flooring Offers Handicap
races.verdict:
DONALD is yet to register a victory but signalled he is ready to strike when a very good recent runner-up at Newcastle so gets the vote. Fellow maiden Zous Juice is feared most on the back of a resurgent second here, while in-form duo Dream Forever and Little Beck Annie also need factoring into this open handicap.

  1. DONALD
  2. ZOUS JUICE (IRE)
  3. DREAM FOREVER (IRE)

races.name: Caple - Built Into Every Great Kitchen Handicap
races.verdict:
ZERMATT STAR showed the benefit of cheekpieces when taking her form up a level to gain a first win at Ripon last week and looks the way to go under a 6 lb penalty. Tee Aitch Aye is feared most on the back of his own recent success at Hamilton, while Hostility can't be discounted in his current vein of form.

  1. ZERMATT STAR (IRE)
  2. TEE AITCH AYE (IRE)
  3. HOSTILITY (IRE)

races.name: Logic's 40th Anniversary Handicap
races.verdict:
VON TROTTER did well to finish runner-up at Chepstow last time given he took a strong hold and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways off just a 1 lb higher mark here. One Night Thunder took this 12 months ago and is feared most having slipped to an attractive mark, while Sandy Craic, They All Know Me and Only Dream Big all need considering too in this competitive handicap.

  1. VON TROTTER
  2. ONE NIGHT THUNDER
  3. SANDY CRAIC (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Free Trial Starts Tomorrow EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KIRTON ANGEL shaped well on her York debut a couple of months ago and can make it second time lucky. Benbecula and Blue Pete are open to improvement and may provide a bigger threat that Deputy Vice, who has had a few chances now.

  1. KIRTON ANGEL (IRE)
  2. BENBECULA (IRE)
  3. BLUE PETE (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
LUMINOUS WARRIOR has got on a roll in recent months and might prove the answer to this big-field handicap. Hatamoto is another who has enjoyed a productive summer and is second choice ahead of fellow 3-y-o Sailor Batt, who was in good form when last seen in the spring. The Childe of Hale can also figure dropping into a Class 6 handicap for the first time.

  1. LUMINOUS WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. HATAMOTO
  3. SAILOR BATT (IRE)

races.name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Unless the betting speaks in the favour of one of the newcomers this looks AL JOLSON's for the taking on the back of a very encouraging second at Southwell.

  1. AL JOLSON
  2. WALK IN PROVENCE (IRE)
  3. STATEIRA BELLE

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
LUCKY HERO has found plenty of improvement since stepped up to 1¼m and might be able to cope with even a 10 lb rise. Thunder Wonder shaped quite well in a competitive Glorious Goodwood handicap last time and is feared most ahead of Lillie Margot, who shapes as if this step up to 1¼m could be in her favour.

  1. LUCKY HERO (IRE)
  2. THUNDER WONDER (IRE)
  3. LILLIE MARGOT

races.name: Constant Security Services Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
PHANTOM SHADOW failed to fire last time but might be worth another chance to confirm the improvement he showed when winning comfortably on his stable debut. Fellow 3-y-o Talitha Rouge ran well for second at Ripon last time and heads the dangers along with Chesneys Charm and Bay Dream Believer.

  1. PHANTOM SHADOW (FR)
  2. TALITHA ROUGE (IRE)
  3. CHESNEYS CHARM

races.name: Constant Security Services Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Perhaps the unexposed handicap newcomers will come to the fore, with Newmarket raider GOLDEN CAVIAR preferred to Ian Jardine's Al Fujairah. Sweet Kiss went close over C&D last time and is next on the list.

  1. GOLDEN CAVIAR (IRE)
  2. AL FUJAIRAH (IRE)
  3. SWEET KISS

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Handicap
races.verdict:
NIGHT EMPEROR was caught away from the main action when fourth to Hurstwood over C&D last time and is taken to resume winning ways now. Peter Niven's C&D specialist remains feasibly treated and might give the selection most to do. Ridgemaster and Stormy Pearl also make the shortlist.

  1. NIGHT EMPEROR (IRE)
  2. HURSTWOOD
  3. RIDGEMASTER (IRE)

races.name: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
A huge-field handicap in which cases can be made for several. PISANELLO continued his good spell despite having his winning run ended when runner-up at Leicester last month and David O'Meara's 9-y-o can add a fourth success of the season to his tally from an unchanged mark. Here Comes Louie is a 3-y-o knocking at the door, so he heads up the dangers, with Falcon Nine, The New Bay Pearl and Yafaarr just a handful of others to consider, too.

  1. PISANELLO (IRE)
  2. HERE COMES LOUIE
  3. FALCON NINE
